findings.text: the row labels revision ed94158e3 "HEAD" while ed94158e3 is the dispatch base and the landed head is 02c315c41, so a reader reconciling the archive against the commit is handed a revision label the landed comment never sat at.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against base ed94158e3 — 23b100901 adds the two test cases and the two doc records, 02c315c41 changes only the cap's comment and the test's docstring, and no executable statement differs from the base.
item_verdicts.done_when: read the node's clause — a catalog-driven saturation case that fails at base d31f8cb92 — and it is unsatisfiable, because both channels close at their own caps and the bound is their sum, so the catalog route never exceeds it; the run's recorded resume-1-advice.txt accepts the over-supplied construction in its place, and the base log shows the landed file failing there with `assert 55 == 30` at test_review_comparator_budget.py:237.
item_verdicts.goal: read the source goal — make the comparator neighbourhood's terminal cap fail a test when it is removed; deleting the terminal break at imas_codex/standard_names/review/enrichment.py:405 from a scratch copy of the landed HEAD 02c315c41 reddens tests/standard_names/test_review_comparator_budget.py:237 with `assert 55 == 30`, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: read /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/terminal-cap-guard/manifest.md; it names head-tests-final.log at 4 passed, base-tests-final.log at 2 failed and 2 passed, and negative-control-terminal-cap-removed.log at 1 failed and 3 passed, and my own runs from a git-archive extraction of the landed tree reproduce 4 passed at HEAD and exactly 1 failed, 3 passed under the declared mutation.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the node's three declared paths and the diff ed94158e3..02c315c41; the test file and both doc records are inside them, while imas_codex/standard_names/review/enrichment.py:394-402 is a fourth file the dispatch fence did not name and the coordinator's recorded resume advice directed.

justifications.durability: the declared negative control reddens only the over-supplied case, and its docstring at tests/standard_names/test_review_comparator_budget.py:182-197 tells a later reader why an over-supplied channel is the only input that can exercise the cap.
justifications.evidence: every record the manifest names reproduces, but the gate cannot show the catalog route failing at test_review_comparator_budget.py:178, which passes with the cap removed, and the done_when's base clause stays unmet.
justifications.fit: the file follows the sibling tests/standard_names idiom of module-level helpers and monkeypatch, and no commit message, comment or symbol carries a plan label, ticket reference or attribution.
justifications.goal_fidelity: removing the break at imas_codex/standard_names/review/enrichment.py:405 from the committed tree leaves exactly one failure at tests/standard_names/test_review_comparator_budget.py:237, so the cap does fail a test when it is removed.
justifications.scope_discipline: four paths land against three declared write paths, the extra being the comment-only hunk at imas_codex/standard_names/review/enrichment.py:394-402 that the coordinator's resume advice ordered rather than the fence.
